description: This source file defines extension methods for configuring grain call filters within the Orleans.Hosting namespace. It provides methods to add incoming and outgoing grain call filters to a client builder, supporting both direct filter instances, implementation types, and delegate-based configurations.

classes.name: ClientBuilderGrainCallFilterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for adding grain call filters to an IClientBuilder.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter to the client builder's filter pipeline, using a filter instance.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter to the filter pipeline, specifying the implementation type.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter (delegate version)
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter via a delegate.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter to the filter pipeline, using a filter instance.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter to the filter pipeline, specifying the implementation type.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter (delegate version)
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter via a delegate.
